artifact_id.description: ID of the registered artifact to ingest. Must reference a pdf_report, html_report, or text artifact. Give this or url, not both.

url.description: Fetch the report from this http(s) URL instead of a loaded artifact. A web page is converted to Markdown and read whole when it fits one call, split at headings when it does not; a link to a PDF is read as a PDF. Only the one document is fetched - no link on it is followed - and private, loopback and cloud-metadata addresses are refused. The fetched copy is registered as an artifact, so a re-run by artifact_id reads the same bytes. Give this or artifact_id, not both.

source_context.description: Optional analyst-provided context about the report source, e.g., 'Mandiant APT29 report from March 2026' or 'CISA advisory AA26-073A'. Improves LLM extraction quality.

ioc_types.description: IOC types to extract. If omitted, all supported types are extracted.

confidence_threshold.description: Minimum confidence for including an extracted IOC. 'low' includes regex-matched IOCs that may be false positives (e.g., version numbers misidentified as IPs). 'high' includes only IOCs confirmed by LLM contextual analysis.

max_pages.description: Optional cost ceiling on pages read from a PDF. Omit it to read the whole document: the page limit that matters is the selected provider's (gcp_gemini 1000, anthropic/openai 100), enforced before the call. Set this only to cap cost deliberately - pages beyond it are reported as pages_dropped, not silently ignored.
